content.value: A counter flow concentric tube heat exchanger used for engine cooling has been in service for an extended period of time. The heat transfer surface area of the exchanger is $5 m ^ { 2 }$ and the design value of the overall convection coefficient is 38 $W / ( m ^ { 2 } . K )$ . During a test run, engine oil flowing at $0 . 1 \ : K g / s$ is cooled from ${ 1 1 0 ^ { \circ } \complement }$ to $6 6 ^ { \circ } \mathbb { C }$ by water supplied at a temperature of $2 5 \mathrm { } ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and a flow rate of $0 . 2 \ : K g / s$ . Determine whether fouling has occurred during the service period. If so, calculate the fouling factor, $R ^ { \prime \prime } { } _ { f } ( m ^ { 2 } . K / W )$ . Given that for engine oil $( \bar { T } _ { h } = 3 6 1 \ : K )$ , C = 2166 $J / K g . K$ and for water $( \bar { T } _ { c } = 3 0 4 K )$ $c = "$ $4 1 7 8 J / K g . K$
